description: The file contains unit tests for the DefaultMetricsConfig class in the metrics configuration package of the Eclipse Ditto services utilities. It tests immutability, equality, and getter methods for default and configured metric settings.

classes.name: DefaultMetricsConfigTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of DefaultMetricsConfig, including immutability, equality, and getter correctness under default and configured settings.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the static configuration object 'metricsTestConf' by loading 'metrics-test' configuration data.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that instances of DefaultMetricsConfig are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations for DefaultMetricsConfig.

methods.name: gettersReturnDefaultValuesIfNotConfigured
methods.description: Tests that getters return default values when no configuration is provided.

methods.name: gettersReturnConfiguredValues
methods.description: Tests that getters return configured values when provided by the configuration.
